summary: Public projects created on 2 November 2026: 7 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: New repositories covered agent tooling and local speech work, with two agent plugins for text-to-speech and staged transcription. Other projects included a handwriting recognition model, an Android clock widget, a manual-rewriting tool, and Konsole settings for Claude Code sessions. On Hugging Face, the new dataset was one speaker reading desktop voice commands.

projects.name: Claude Konsole Setup
projects.description: Konsole settings for running Claude Code sessions: window-close protection, no single-tab prompt, split layout; apply.sh for other machines

projects.name: Daniel Handwriting Recognition
projects.description: Fine-tuning a handwriting recognition (HTR) model on Daniel's handwriting: data collection plan, ground truth, training

projects.name: Laptop Search 1126
projects.description: Laptop search, November 2026: requirements, spec notes and voice-note transcripts.

projects.name: Local TTS Plugin
projects.description: Local text-to-speech for Claude Code: Kokoro (CPU), NeuTTS Air (CPU cloning), Chatterbox (ROCm/CUDA). Installs, registers and runs local TTS models.

projects.name: Local UTC Widget
projects.description: Android home-screen widget: local time and UTC side by side, 24-hour, with optional date, UTC offset and font choice

projects.name: Transcription Pipeline
projects.description: Agent skills for transcription in stages: retrieve, preprocess (EQ, denoise, VAD), transcribe (OpenRouter/Gemini, AssemblyAI, local Whisper/Parakeet), clean, label speakers, reshape, Typst PDF, save

projects.name: Useful User Manuals
projects.description: Turn bloated product manuals into useful ones: fetch, trim to your language, rewrite, or one-task how-to PDFs, always citing the original.

projects.name: Voice Command Sentences
projects.description: One speaker reading desktop voice commands for a KDE Plasma voice-command agent: launching, switching to and closing apps (Konsole, Kate, Dolphin, Kdenlive, Audacity), browser and terminal tabs,...
